About the Scholarship

ReD Global is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master on religious diversity in a globalised world, coordinated from the University of Coimbra with Groningen and other partners. Applications for the Erasmus Mundus scholarship round run from October to mid-January each year, with the mid-January date the practical cut-off.

OpportunityReD Global – Erasmus Mundus Master in Religious Diversity in a Globalised World
HostReD Global Consortium (University of Coimbra)
LocationCoimbra (multi-country mobility), Portugal
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students:
Application Deadline15 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

ReD Global is a two-year Erasmus Mundus master on religious diversity in a globalised world, coordinated from the University of Coimbra with Groningen and other partners. Applications for the Erasmus Mundus scholarship round run from October to mid-January each year, with the mid-January date the practical cut-off.

Programme Highlights

  • Coimbra-led programme with double degrees across the consortium
  • October-to-January annual application rhythm
  • Research training on religion, migration and pluralism
  • Doctoral pathways and NGO/policy careers for graduates

Who Should Apply

Humanities and social-science graduates — theology, history, sociology, anthropology, law — with research interest in religion and society.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: participation costs plus monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the ReD Global site during the October-January window and confirm the exact mid-January date on the call page. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (expected — applications accepted October to mid-January each year).

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About ReD Global Consortium (University of Coimbra)

The ReD Global consortium is coordinated by the University of Coimbra and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Religious Diversity in a Globalised World with European partners.

Official website: https://www.red-global.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
